heading: Our suite of mobile app development platforms
text2: KeyDevs Technologies has a large pool of developers who build apps with the top native and cross platform technologies.

items.title: iPhone App Development
items.text: Swift and Objective-C power the best apps on the App Store. Our iOS developers build fast, secure and beautifully designed iPhone and iPad apps that follow Apple’s design guidelines and get approved quickly.

items.title: Android App Development
items.text: With Kotlin, Java and Material Design, we build Android apps that run reliably across thousands of devices. From simple utilities to complex marketplaces, our Android team has you covered.

items.title: Flutter App Development
items.text: Flutter gives you a single codebase for iOS and Android with expressive UI and native performance. Choose it to launch faster and keep your design consistent on every device.

items.title: Cross Platform Development
items.text: When you need one product everywhere, our cross platform engineers pick the right framework and build a single app that works across iOS, Android and the web.

items.title: AR App Development
items.text: Bring products and places to life with augmented reality. We build ARKit and ARCore apps for retail, real estate, education and entertainment.

items.title: VR App Development
items.text: Immersive virtual reality apps for training, tours and entertainment, built for Oculus, Google VR and mixed reality devices.
